1.title: The Red Woman

candidates.text: In Braavos, blinded Arya begs on the street; each day a young woman beats her with a staff.
candidates.grounded_in: In Braavos, a blinded Arya begs on the street. Each day, the Waif beats her with a staff and forces her to fight.

candidates.text: Davos and a handful of loyalists bolt themselves inside a room at Castle Black with Jon's body.
candidates.grounded_in: Ser Davos and several loyalists bolt themselves inside a room with Jon's body

candidates.text: Edd slips away from Castle Black alone to look for help.
candidates.grounded_in: Edd leaves Castle Black to seek help

candidates.text: Jorah and Daario are still out in the grasslands, following the trail left behind by Daenerys.
candidates.grounded_in: Jorah and Daario Naharis continue tracking Daenerys

candidates.text: Tyrion and Varys walk together through Meereen and look out over the harbour, where ships are burning.
candidates.grounded_in: In Meereen, Tyrion and Varys discover ships are burning in the harbor.

1.note: Melisandre's necklace scene, the Dornish killings, and Brienne's rescue of Sansa are all excluded as reveals/turning points.
